Woman's bank account shows ₹740 crore instead of pension amount

A woman in Nawada, Bihar, went to a bank to withdraw ₹1,100 for her pension and was shocked to find ₹740 crore in her account. Another report states a student went to withdraw ₹900 and saw ₹7,596,951,951 in her account. The large sum caused distress to the woman and her family. The bank has reportedly explained the reason for the erroneous balance.
